payload.name: spectral-band-entropy
payload.scope: A spectral feature that quantifies the uncertainty or information content of the normalized energy distribution within a frequency band, computed using Shannon entropy over the probability mass function of per-bin energies.

payload.body: For a frequency band with N energy bins having energies E₁, E₂, ..., Eₙ and total energy E_total = ΣEᵢ, the normalized probability mass function is pᵢ = Eᵢ / E_total. The spectral-band-entropy is H = -Σ pᵢ log₂(pᵢ), where the sum runs over all bins in the band with pᵢ > 0. H measures the uniformity of energy distribution: H = 0 when all energy concentrates in one bin, and H is maximized when energy is uniformly distributed across all bins. [formal: mathematics | substrate: mind | horizon: a moment | explicit: yes | epoch: 0.01]
